verdict.rationale: Otter.ai offers a public API, webhooks, and an MCP server, so a separate sandbox or test environment is a fair question to ask. However, the evidence pack never mentions a sandbox, test environment, dry-run mode, or any way to keep test traffic apart from production meeting data. OAuth scoping that limits which meetings an AI assistant can access is an access control, not sandbox isolation, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
